name: zen-sidebar
description: Web panel sidebar extension for Zen, Firefox and Chrome

scripts.lint: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --firefox "C:\Program Files\Zen Browser\zen.exe" --firefox-profile dev-profile
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename web_panels_sidebar_chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign: npm run build:firefox && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --channel unlisted
